policies.ownership: Live count-one real WeaponItems source; original reference uniquely owned in inventory hotbar/loadout. No proc or persistent state.
policies.initialization: JSON-only. Canonical registries checked lazily in supports(entry).
policies.testing: User simple-stat exception: no numerical-only unit tests, whole gate or Vision. Master owns integration.
policies.apply: Master wraps WeaponSlickdraw.handlingTicks(player,stack,ready,base) and adsTicks(player,entry,base,entering) outermost. Raw Handling25+100 saturates100; ready .95 only; stow and ADS scalar1.
policies.incoming: Ready accepts exact original owned incoming hotbar item before actual selection. Stow and ADS require current selected held source. No stored proc or selecting hook.
policies.composition: No speculative companion scalar or rounded-duration composition. Other positive raw handling buffs are redundant at100.
policies.autoAim: BASIC -20% Auto Aim Cone Size is source-only and unsimulated; no spread penalty invented. Enhanced -15%? excluded.

curveProof.calculation: ceil(rawSeconds(100) * (0.95 iff ready else 1) * 20); ADS clamp2..20; never scale rounded ticks
curveProof.units: Historical W46 community seconds mapped to local20TPS. Not a current exact Destiny animation measurement.

displayProperties.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.
displayProperties.name: Explosive Payload

ddc.name: Explosive Payload
ddc.baseText: 91 Explosive Payload Weapons deal 50% of their Non-Precision Direct Impact Damage as an Explosive Payload . Explosive Payload detonates on impact, damaging enemies within 3 meters. Explosive Payload portion deals 30% increased [7% decreased on Hand Cannons] damage and inflicts increased stagger. Impact Damage's Precision Multiplier is increased to offset the Explosive Payload portion lacking the ability to score Precision Hits . New Ratio = (Base Ratio - 50%) / (1 - 50%) Overall Damage Increase: Damage is increased by 15% of the Weapon's Bodyshot Damage. Precision Damage Increase is equal to 15% / Precision Multiplier . Bodyshot damage remains the same. Precision Damage remains "roughly" the same.
ddc.rawHTML:
91
Explosive Payload
Weapons deal 50% of their Non-Precision Direct Impact Damage as an Explosive Payload.
Explosive Payload detonates on impact, damaging enemies within 3 meters.
Explosive Payload portion deals 30% increased [7% decreased on Hand Cannons] damage and inflicts increased stagger.

Impact Damage's Precision Multiplier is increased to offset the Explosive Payload portion lacking the ability to score Precision Hits.
New Ratio = (Base Ratio - 50%) / (1 - 50%)

Overall Damage Increase:
Damage is increased by 15% of the Weapon's Bodyshot Damage. Precision Damage Increase is equal to 15% / Precision Multiplier.
Bodyshot damage remains the same. Precision Damage remains "roughly" the same.

↑Passively grants +5 Reload Speed.
